title: AuthoringConversationView
description: 200 response body of GET /api/authoring/conversations/:id (HEL-397 design.md D7, generalized by HEL-411 design.md D3/D4) — the display-only subset a reloaded chat surface needs to rehydrate a visible thread. RLS-scoped to the owner; 404 for a missing or non-owned id. The server-internal apiHistory (the raw Claude conversation shape) never leaves the server — it is not part of this shape. Exactly one of latestProposal/latestPatchSet is ever populated for a real conversation id (an authoring conversation carries latestProposal; a refinement conversation carries latestPatchSet) — never both.

conversationId.description: The id supplied in the request path, echoed back.

displayTurns.description: One entry per turn so far — a user turn's own typed text verbatim, or a deterministic "Proposed \"<name>\" (<n> panel(s))" summary for an assistant turn (never raw model JSON).

latestProposal.description: The current working proposal for an AUTHORING conversation — what "review & apply" hands off. Absent for a refinement conversation.

latestPatchSet.description: The current working patch set for a REFINEMENT conversation (HEL-411) — what "review & apply" hands off to /patch-sets/review. Absent for an authoring conversation.
